decision: Keep bounded file-read retention; remove TEST_EVIDENCE_GUIDANCE from production execution and validation prompts. Preserve it only as an experimental arm.
basis: With the old prompt, retained reads produced all 15 oracle-matching decisions; the old renderer produced 14/15, including one acceptance of the insufficient original suite. Both arms with the added guidance rejected the conforming case in all three repeats, asking for more evidence.
interpretation: The oracle labels describe actual test adequacy and runtime behavior for the scoped rules. A refusal asking for omitted setup evidence is not an invented implementation defect. These counts do not prove general accuracy or that all guidance-induced refusals are wrong.
limitations: Three repeats per case on one model, one application and one day.
Controlled reconstruction with synthetic trailing catalogue probes; not the complete production acceptance prompt or an end-to-end Atoma run.
The positive case tests the three scoped rules, not all library requirements.
No production deployment or new application run was performed.
